card.name: Sentence ends and section-title starts
card.fires_on: Sentence-ending periods in human rights or geography reports, and the first word of a new section heading such as Compatibility or Stability in drug labels. It also fires on the ending of Carcinogenicity or Fertility in the toxicology heading.

modes.label: Period in country reports
modes.description: The full stop closing a sentence about killings, injuries or town geography, just before the next sentence starts.
modes.example: there were no reported mob killings of persons suspected of witchcraft<<. >>There were no reports of politically motivated disappear

modes.label: Label section heading word
modes.description: A heading word like Stability or Compatibility starting a new drug label section after a sentence ends.

modes.label: Toxicology heading ending
modes.description: The closing part of a word in the Carcinogenesis, Mutagenesis, Fertility heading.
modes.example: Carcinogenic<<ity>> studies were carried out in male and female

card.writes: It suppresses Chinese noun-phrase endings such as 的意义 and 的特点, so it adds no clear English effect.
card.plain: It marks a spot where one sentence or section ends and a new one begins, in country reports and drug label headings.
